svg.title: lucasCore blueprint: scenarios, stages and datasheets
svg.text: SyncroSim 3 add-on to ST-Sim 4.5 · version 1.0.0 · 15 stages in src/ · the scenarios they run in and the datasheets they pass on
(used when a sheet is left empty)
Depends on the Build result, then on
Depends on Projection Setup, Projection Climate
and the Build result. Mode 1: one continuous run;
mode 2 starts from a historical run's final maps.

Solid arrows: a datasheet one stage writes and a later stage reads. Dashed: a scenario dependency (the dependency supplies its sheets; the first one with rows wins). Chips: the stages that read a data group, or write a sheet.
Every stage also writes the Validation sheet. Generated by docs/blueprint/build.R from package.xml (lucasCore 1.0.0), 2026-10-29.
